title: A Transcendental Experience
text:
This review is for our touring company called “Not Just A Tourist” and it’s for our tour from Seville to Tangier. 

Fernando picked us up near our hotel and we made our trek to Tangier, passing many cities along the way until we arrived at the port in Tarifa.  Fernando is bilingual (English and Spanish) and was a great tour guide and very knowledgeable about the area. He explained how the process would work and whom we would meet in Tangier.

Once we crossed the continent and arrived in Tangier, we met with Sharif who welcomed us with open arms. Sharif was by far the best walking tour guide we
author: Udall

title: Best way to experience Seville
text: Guille was a fantastic guide, highly knowledgeable and really knew his food. We had a wonderful time and the food was exceptional. Highly recommend for all foodies, We will remember this experience for a very long time, Thank you so much Guille.
author: terrimY1640OQ

title: Our guide Guille + tapas in Alameda = an excellent tour
text: We took the Off The Beaten Path Tapas Tour and our guide, Guille, provided us with a fantastic evening. He did a great job of mixing history, culture, and food & drinks through the tour. He ordered his favorites and recommendations, ensuring our tastes and preferences were taken into account. Overall we couldn’t have asked for a better night full of great food, interesting area highlights, and best of all the hospitality of our host and guide. If you’re lucky enough to book a tour with Guille, you’ll have a very enjoyable experience.
author: Roving362892

title: Food, fun, great food
text: Wow.WOW. We turned up and unknowingly to me, and I booked, it was a personal tour. So just 2 of us and the guild. She took us to all her favourite hot spots in Seville. These restaurants were all off the beaten track and were the locals eat. The guild has lived and worked in Seville for 9 years, so knew the area very well. We tried food we would never of ordered off a menu. We like and know food but some of the tapas we tried was unreal. This was an AMAZING tour. 100% book this when you come. The guild was lovely and friendy .. a must for food lovers 😋
author: I5212NHchristiana

title: One of the best food tours I've done
text: Definitely one of the best food tours I've done. Oscar did a great job. I don't have any food restrictions and love it when a guide can take me off the beaten track without holding back. He is kniws a lot about food. We had Amazing food, conversation and history. I definitely recommend.
author: Alex_H

title: Fantastic Food Tour
text: We had a great night touring Seville’s tapas bars. Our guide Oscar took us to some great bars which we would never have found without Oscar’s local knowledge. Oscar introduced us to dishes we may not have normally considered in addition to some classic tapas from the region. Oscar is passionate about food and local culture and is an entertaining guide. We would definitely book again.
author: alanr189

title: Perfect relaxed tour!
text: Robert was a  perfect  match for us, as a tour guide! He spoke perfect English, which was great for us, to understand, since we are from the USA!  He was a wealth of knowledge of Seville day-to-day culture, history, traditions, and hidden treasures.
author: Curious474130

title: Tapas tour Seville
text: I did the off the beaten path tapas tour near Alameda de Hercules. Abby was a great and fun guide, giving cultural and historical info as we went to different places. She showed me great new tapas dishes both traditional and modern that I would not have discovered otherwise
author: 305jeremyl

title: Triana tapas tour
text: The Triana tapas tour was so much fun. The selections of restaurants and also the food were excellent. Abby’s stories about the history of Seville and her own personal experiences made it feel as if we were walking around with a very knowledgeable and charming friend. Highly recommend!
author: janedT1011QL

title: Best part of our Spain trip
text: My daughter and I had such a special time with Abbie.  it was one of those magical evenings that we will always remember. The food was delicious, the restaurants she took us to were authentic and friendly , and she was just such a delightful person. I cannot recommend this opportunity or Abbie high enough!!!
author: Mitra_C
